We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: step1 forward: carboxylic acid to amide (coupling). So retrosynthesis: break amide bond to give carboxylic acid and amine.

Step2 forward: Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (the /C=C/C(=O)N...). So retrosynthesis: break the C=C double bond and carboxylic acid to give aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually Doebner gives unsaturated acid from aldehyde + malonic acid. So reverse: our unsaturated acid fragment (c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)N... )cc2) came from aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). So we need to split that.

Step3 forward: sulfonamide formation: amine reacts with sulfonyl chloride. So retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2Cl) and amine (the aniline). Our target has NS(=O)(=O) attached to aromatic ring (para to methyl). So we can break to give p-toluidine (or p-methyl aniline) and p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride? Actually the sulfonyl part is attached to aromatic ring with sulfonamide linking to second aromatic ring (the unsaturated amide). The sulfonyl group attached to first phenyl ring (with methyl). So sulfonamide formation: Ar-NH-SO2-Ar'. So retrosynthesis: break N-S bond to give Ar-NH2 (p-toluidine) and Ar'-SO2Cl (the sulfonyl chloride derived from second phenyl ring). The second phenyl ring is the one bearing the unsaturated amide side chain. So we need to generate that sulfonyl chloride from that phenyl ring.

Thus three steps: 1) amide formation (break amide). 2) Doebner modification (break unsaturated acid to aldehyde + malonic acid). 3) sulfonamide formation (break N-S to give aniline and sulfonyl chloride).

We need to produce JSON route with three reaction nodes.

We need template IDs for each transformation. We can search for templates matching criteria.

First, sulfonamide formation: functional groups broken: amine? Actually forward: amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide. So broken: sulfonyl chloride (S-Cl) and amine N-H? The functional groups formed: sulfonamide. Use search with functional_groups_broken ["sulfonyl chloride"]? Not in list. Available functional groups list includes "sulfonamides", "sulfonic", "sulfones". Not sulfonyl chloride. Could use bonds broken "S-Cl". Let's search.
